pageSummary:
Client Background
The American Institute for Economic Research (AIER), founded in 1933 by economist and financial advisor Colonel Edward C. Harwood, is the oldest economic research institute in the United States. AIER is a nonpartisan research and education nonprofit 501(c)(3) organization focused on the importance of markets, educating people on the value of personal freedom, free enterprise, property rights, limited government, and sound money. Based in Great Barrington, Massachusetts, AIER has maintained its prestigious position in economic research for over 90 years, with scholars regularly contributing to major publications and media outlets.

Project Goals & Challenges

Primary Objectives

  • Legacy System Migration: Transition from outdated Drupal 6 to modern Drupal 7 platform
  • Content Consolidation: Streamline multiple content types and eliminate redundant workflows
  • Enhanced User Experience: Implement responsive design with mobile-first approach
  • Content Management Efficiency: Simplify editorial workflows for AIER staff
  • Performance Optimization: Improve site speed and search functionality

Key Challenges

  • Complex Content Architecture: Managing diverse content types including research papers, news articles, educational materials, and multimedia content
  • Workflow Simplification: Consolidating the existing dual-node system (article + bucket nodes) for homepage features
  • Mobile Responsiveness: Ensuring optimal experience across all devices for academic and general audiences
  • SEO & Archival Needs: Maintaining research document accessibility while implementing 12-month display cycles

Technical Architecture & Solutions

Content Management Strategy

Streamlined Content Types
The project consolidated AIER's content architecture into six core content types:

Research Articles

  • Consolidated previous "article" and "bucket" content types
  • Implemented "Promote to Front Page" functionality
  • Added comprehensive taxonomy system for categorization
  • Integrated multimedia assets and related article functionality

News Integration

  • External link optimization for third-party news sources
  • Google Analytics tracking for outbound clicks
  • Simplified workflow eliminating unnecessary detail pages

Product Catalog

  • Authorize.net integration for e-commerce functionality
  • Streamlined product display with embedded checkout

Staff Directory

  • Hierarchical staff categorization
  • Flexible display options for different staff types
  • No detail pages required, maintaining list-view efficiency

Educational Content

  • Standard page template for maximum flexibility
  • WYSIWYG content management
  • Nested block functionality

Video Content

  • YouTube integration
  • Homepage carousel functionality
  • Promotion-based display system

Advanced Taxonomy Implementation

  • Research Categories: Everyday Price Index, Business Cycle Conditions, Research Reports
  • Educational Classifications: Fellowships, Student Programs, Conferences
  • Archive Organization: Historical document categorization
  • Form Campaign Taxonomy: Newsletter and digital download classification

User Experience Enhancements

Responsive Design Features

  • Mobile Navigation: Consolidated utility and main navigation
  • Touch-Optimized Interfaces: Swipeable content carousels
  • Click-to-Call Integration: Direct phone connectivity for mobile users
  • Progressive Enhancement: Desktop features gracefully degraded for mobile

Advanced Functionality

  • Infinite Scroll: Twitter-style content loading for improved engagement
  • Modal Integration: Lightbox functionality for images and embedded content
  • Social Integration: AddThis buttons and Disqus commenting system
  • Cost of Living Calculator: Custom tool migration from D6 to D7

Technical Innovations

Custom Block System

  • Dual Administration: Global top-down and per-page bottom-up block management
  • Featured Content Blocks: Pre-rendered view modes for consistent presentation
  • WYSIWYG Integration: User-friendly content creation tools
  • Modal Functionality: Integrated lightbox capabilities

Search & Performance Optimization

  • Multi-Content Search: Comprehensive search across all content types
  • Google Analytics Integration: Event tracking for user interactions
  • SEO-Friendly URLs: Clean URL structure for research content
  • Archive Management: Automated 12-month display cycles with PDF backup

Integration & Third-Party Services

E-commerce Integration

  • Authorize.net Simple Checkout: Seamless product purchasing
  • Donation Platform: NetworkforGood integration for membership
  • Bookstore Functionality: Product catalog with shopping cart

Communication Tools

  • Email Marketing: Newsletter signup integration
  • Social Media: Multi-platform sharing capabilities
  • External Blog Integration: Daily Economy blog connectivity
  • RSS Feeds: Automated content syndication

Implementation Highlights

Content Migration Strategy

  • Legacy Content Preservation: Maintained all historical research data
  • URL Structure Optimization: SEO-friendly paths for research content
  • Asset Management: Comprehensive image and document handling
  • Taxonomy Mapping: Seamless category transitions

Performance Enhancements

  • Mobile-First Design: Optimized loading for smartphones and tablets
  • Image Optimization: Responsive images with modal enlargement
  • Caching Strategy: Drupal 7 performance optimizations
  • CDN Integration: External script loading via Cloudflare

Quality Assurance Features

  • Link Checker Module: Automated broken link detection
  • Email Obfuscation: Spam protection for contact information
  • Comment Moderation: Admin-reviewed Disqus integration
  • Form Validation: Comprehensive contact form security

Results & Impact

Improved Editorial Workflow

  • Simplified Publishing: Single-node system for homepage features
  • Enhanced Content Organization: Intuitive taxonomy-based categorization
  • Streamlined Asset Management: Integrated multimedia handling
  • Flexible Block System: User-friendly content placement tools

Enhanced User Experience

  • Mobile Accessibility: Fully responsive design across all devices
  • Improved Navigation: Intuitive menu structure with flyout functionality
  • Rich Media Integration: Seamless video and image presentation
  • Advanced Search: Comprehensive content discovery tools

Technical Achievements

  • Modern Platform: Successful Drupal 7 migration with future-proofing
  • Performance Optimization: Faster loading times and improved responsiveness
  • SEO Enhancement: Better search engine visibility for research content
  • Integration Success: Seamless third-party service connectivity

Future Considerations

Scalability Features

  • Content Type Extensions: Framework for additional content types
  • Advanced Charting: Prepared architecture for interactive data visualization
  • Event Management: Placeholder for future event functionality
  • Enhanced Analytics: Framework for detailed user behavior tracking

Technical Evolution

  • Module Ecosystem: Carefully selected Drupal modules for extensibility
  • Security Framework: Robust security measures for academic content
  • Performance Monitoring: Google Analytics integration for ongoing optimization
  • Content Archival: Systematic approach to historical content management

Conclusion
The AIER website redesign and migration project successfully transformed a complex academic institution's digital presence from a legacy Drupal 6 system to a modern, responsive, and user-friendly Drupal 7 platform. By consolidating content types, streamlining editorial workflows, and implementing cutting-edge responsive design principles, the project delivered a comprehensive solution that serves both AIER's diverse content needs and their audience's evolving digital expectations.

The project's success lies in its balanced approach to technical innovation and practical usability, ensuring that AIER's prestigious research and educational content remains accessible and engaging across all digital platforms while providing the institutional flexibility needed for ongoing content management and growth.
